goal: Schritt 1: Palette-Auswahl und rein temporäre Platzierung auf dem 12-Spalten-Canvas im Browserzustand ergänzen. Schritt 2 nach grünem Zwischen-Gate: Rastergrenzen blockieren, Vorschau deterministisch härten und Tastaturbedienung der neuen Interaktion absichern.

guide_delta.summary: Komponenten können im Browserentwurf ausgewählt und auf einer Zielspalte platziert werden. Der Entwurf bleibt flüchtig: kein Speichern, kein POST und kein Datenbankzugriff.

tests_required: Step 1: targeted browser-shell compile and tests
Step 1: selection and placement remain in in-memory browser state
Step 1: no fetch, XHR, browser storage, WebSocket or POST path
Step 1: HTTP surface remains GET-only and loopback-only
Step 2: reject placements whose component width would exceed the 12-column grid
Step 2: deterministic preview order and identifiers
Step 2: keyboard placement contract using native buttons plus explicit focus navigation
Step 2: final targeted UI and repository-foundation gates
tests_explicitly_not_run: full suite because the change is isolated to the browser mask-builder shell
database regressions because no database dependency or route is introduced
template-store tests because persistence remains explicitly out of scope
screenshot gate because I99 is interaction hardening rather than a visual redesign or five-iteration screenshot milestone
risks: browser-only interaction is intentionally ephemeral and disappears on reload
Step 1 does not yet reject a target column that would be invalid for wider component defaults
no persistent template semantics are introduced in this iteration
non_changes: no database, repository, CatalogService, writer or SQL access
expected_side_effects: users can create a temporary visual draft by selecting a palette component and a target column
reloading the page intentionally clears the draft
